actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean FOUR FULL-BODY VIEW character turnaround of the EXACT tiny DeepSeek whale-hat child in REFERENCE IMAGE 1, the original sunlit market illustration where she holds a large metal bowl of rice. The user has expressly made THIS ORIGINAL IMAGE the primary authority over all derived cards. Match reference1's facial shape, large lively blue eyes, rounded cheeks, bangs and wavy hair silhouette, original head-to-body ratio, short limbs, little whale cap and cherubic baby-like anime appeal. She must feel like the exact child from that first picture merely standing neutrally and seen from different angles. Do not make her older, taller, thin-faced, realistically proportioned, or a maid. Reference2 is a supporting outfit-detail breakdown ONLY; if its face/body/hair proportions differ, always follow reference1. Keep the original's soft painterly anime rendering, luminous but gently shaded face and richly detailed blue hair and fabric. Neutral grey-background studio illumination may replace market lighting for legibility, without changing original base colors.
Preserve the original oversized stuffed blue whale-shaped cap with round dark whale eyes, pink cheeks, white fluffy mouth/brim, two-lobed spout on top, fins and a small tail at hat rear; deep blue-violet hair fading to pale blue ends and blue eyes. Preserve original navy short coat/cape dress, white fluffy collar/cuffs/hem, white snowflakes, pale blue wave trim, blue bows and white pom-poms, original short navy winter boots. Reference2 may supply consistent embroidery, closure and back coat bow/whale-fluke structure where the original cannot show them. Exactly one body whale tail behind lower coat; distinguish from the cap's separate sewn whale tail. No other props: remove rice basin ONLY to expose clothing and relaxed hands, do not interpret removing it as changing the child's design.
Exactly four whole-body figures in a single horizontal row, same character, same scale, identical relaxed standing pose rotated. Left-to-right: straight front; true 90-degree profile nose pointing to image LEFT; straight back head and body facing away; true 90-degree profile nose pointing to image RIGHT. Complete whale spout, cap, hair, hands, tail, coat, legs and boots in every view without clipping. Align the cap height and boot soles, keep enough clear vertical blank space between characters. Arms relaxed just away from coat, feet gently apart grounded, calm sweet expression retaining original lively eyes and cheerful nature. No running, no lifted leg, no pointing. Tail and hair anatomy coherent across views; don't just mirror asymmetric cap/coat details. Use roughly 3:1 wide landscape at highest practical resolution, near orthographic level camera, opaque pale warm-grey background, gentle contact shadows. Exactly four full-body figures only: no big portrait, no additional expression or detail panels. NO text or labels, no prompts or prompt area, no title, no watermark, no frame or color swatches. Preserve reference1 identity and original chibi proportion above all.
